issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): the problem statement UML (class diagram) declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int, while the template hint/comment and the solution implementation declare and implement getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as double. This mismatch can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause compilation/test failures if they follow the UML or follow the template inconsistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double so it matches the template hint and the solution implementation (and update any textual references if present). Alternatively, if integer semantics were intended, change the template hint and the solution method signature to int. Favor double for precision and update tests/documentation accordingly.
